text: Each of you writes three columns: yes, no, maybe. Swap lists. Ask about the one maybe that made you lean in.
aftercare: Thank them for one answer that took courage, and mean it.

text: Name one hard limit and one curious maybe. The limit needs no explanation. The maybe gets all the questions.
aftercare: Hold hands and repeat their hard limit back so they know you heard it.

text: Choose a safeword together. Bonus if it makes you both laugh. Then practice saying it once, completely seriously.
aftercare: Seal the safeword with a slow kiss and a promise to always honor it.

text: Describe a fantasy in vivid detail. Your partner listens without touching you. Not even a little.
aftercare: Let them close the gap: one long hug, no words needed.

text: What would make you feel completely safe trying something new? Answer in detail while your partner takes notes.
aftercare: Read their notes back to them and ask if you got it right.

text: Rate these 1 to 5 out loud: being told what to do, being blindfolded, being praised, being teased. Compare scores.
aftercare: Tell them which of their answers you'll be thinking about tomorrow.

text: Agree on traffic lights: green means more, yellow means slow down, red means stop. Then whisper 'green' and see what happens.
aftercare: Check in after: what color are you now, and what do you need?

text: Confess one thing you've wanted to try but were too shy to ask for. Your partner may only reply 'tell me more.'
aftercare: Kiss their forehead and tell them nothing they said could make you think less of them.

text: Negotiate a scene like a contract: who leads, how long, what's on the table, what's off. Sign it with a kiss.
aftercare: Review the 'contract' afterward and agree on one clause to change next time.

text: Answer by pointing: where do you love being touched, where is off-limits tonight, and where are you curious?
aftercare: Wrap them in a blanket and tell them one answer that surprised you.

text: Praise only: for five minutes, tell your partner exactly what they're doing right. Be specific. Watch them glow.
aftercare: Ask which compliment landed hardest, then say it once more, slowly.

text: Whisper an order across the room. Something small: come here, sit closer, take one thing off. They may say yes or no.
aftercare: When they do it, thank them like it's the best gift you've had all week.

text: Make your partner earn permission to kiss you. Set the task: a compliment, a confession, a back rub. Then grant it generously.
aftercare: Tell them what made you say yes, and give them one kiss for free.

text: For 10 minutes, your partner gives every instruction. You may only answer 'yes' or the safeword.
aftercare: Trade places for a slow hug and ask how it felt to hand over the wheel.

text: Service hour: one of you is cared for completely. Drinks brought, shoulders rubbed, clothes removed on request. They lift nothing.
aftercare: Whoever served gets ten minutes of being held, no questions asked.

text: No hands. Tease your partner using only your lips, your voice, and the brush of your hair against their skin.
aftercare: Then use your hands for something gentle: stroke their hair until they melt.

text: Halfway through, switch who's in charge. Whoever led first now follows whatever the new boss decides.
aftercare: Tell each other which half you liked better, and why.

text: Your partner sits, stands, or kneels exactly where you point. Keep them waiting for the next instruction. Make the pause delicious.
aftercare: Bring them a glass of water and sit at eye level to check in.

text: Set one rule for tonight, like 'ask before you touch' or 'call me by a title.' Each slip earns a playful consequence you agreed on first.
aftercare: Forgive every slip with a kiss and tell them they did beautifully.

text: Secretly signal: do you want a full power exchange tonight? One leads, one follows, safeword always honored. Only if everyone says yes.
aftercare: Lie close for ten minutes after and trade one thing you loved about how the other led or followed.

text: Tell your partner to undress slowly while you stay fully clothed and watch. Narrate what you like. No touching until you say so.
aftercare: Wrap them in your shirt or a soft blanket and tell them how gorgeous they looked.

text: Your partner may not finish, or even ask to, until you grant permission. You decide how long. They decide if it's too long.
aftercare: Hold them close and tell them how proud you are of their patience.

text: Lead your partner to the bedroom by the hand. At every step, tell them in a low voice exactly what's about to happen.
aftercare: Once it's over, tell them what you'll remember most and let them choose the cuddle position.

text: Write three orders on scraps of paper, each bolder than the last. Your partner draws one at a time and may veto any with the safeword.
aftercare: Read the unused orders aloud together and decide which to save for next time.

text: Blindfold your partner. Kiss them somewhere unexpected every 30 seconds. They guess where you'll land next.
aftercare: Remove the blindfold slowly so the first thing they see is your smile.

text: Trace slow letters on their back with a feather. They have to guess the secret word you're spelling.
aftercare: Whisper the real word and tell them why you picked it.

text: Warm drink in one hand, ice cube in the other. Alternate kisses: hot, cold, hot. They pick which wins.
aftercare: Share the rest of the warm drink under one blanket.

text: Tie their wrists loosely with a soft scarf. Quick-release knot, scissors in reach, and check they can slip free. Then take your time.
aftercare: Untie them gently, rub their wrists, and ask what felt best.

text: Touch everywhere except where they want it most, until they ask nicely. You get to define 'nicely.'
aftercare: Give them exactly what they asked for, then hold them until they're calm again.

text: Scratch their back slowly, light to firm. They call out 'more' or 'less.' Keep it gentle enough that nothing lingers.
aftercare: Smooth lotion along every path you scratched.

text: Negotiate a spanking first: where, how firm, how many. Count them out loud together. Stop the instant the safeword lands.
aftercare: Rub the spot soothingly and tell them how much you trust them.

text: Blindfold on. Run five textures over their skin: silk, fur, something cool and metal, a soft brush, your lips. They rank them.
aftercare: Let them do the same to you, then compare your top picks.

text: Drag an ice cube slowly down their spine. Chase every drop with a warm kiss.
aftercare: Dry them off with a warm towel and keep them wrapped in it.

text: Secretly signal: soft ties tonight? Quick-release knots, scissors nearby, safeword ready. It only happens if everyone says yes.
aftercare: Release them slowly, massage where the ties were, and tell them what their trust felt like.

text: Blindfold and soft ties together, quick release in reach. They can't see or reach you. Tell them everything you're about to do, then do it.
aftercare: Unwrap them like a gift, then hold them until they're ready to talk.

text: Bring them right to the edge, then stop. Three times. On the fourth, they decide what happens.
aftercare: Bring them water, brush their hair back, and tell them they were incredible.

text: Pin their wrists gently above their head with one hand. Explore with the other. Let go the instant they ask.
aftercare: Kiss each wrist, then lace your fingers through theirs.

text: Sensory overload: blindfold, slow music, ice in one of your hands, a feather in the other. Ask 'color?' every few minutes.
aftercare: Take it all away one sense at a time, then finish with a long, quiet hug.

text: Strangers at a bar: each of you invents a name, a job, and one secret. Meet across the room and try to pick each other up.
aftercare: Drop character with a real kiss and tell them your favorite line of theirs.

text: One of you writes a very specific job title; the other writes three 'qualifications.' Hold the interview. Hire only if truly convinced.
aftercare: Give them a glowing performance review: three things they did that you loved.

text: The masseuse: agree on the menu beforehand. One books the deluxe treatment; the other decides, within the menu, what's included.
aftercare: Swap roles for a five-minute shoulder rub with no agenda at all.

text: Consensual boss and new hire, both adults, both very into it. Write the office rules together first, then hold a 'performance review.'
aftercare: Clock out together: comfy clothes, a snack, and a debrief.

text: Consensual royal and bodyguard. Decide together beforehand: who's sworn to protect whom, and which forbidden line gets crossed tonight?
aftercare: Out of character, tell them one moment that felt truly romantic.

text: Write a scene on three index cards: beginning, middle, end. Swap cards and act out your partner's version.
aftercare: Keep the cards, and tell them which line made you blush most.

text: Photographer and model. Each writes one pose the other may request. Run a shoot with no camera, only direction and praise.
aftercare: Tell them one 'shot' you'll be replaying in your head all week.

text: Each of you writes a secret scene on a card. Swap and read silently. Signal yes or no. You play it only if everyone says yes.
aftercare: Whatever the answer, thank them for trusting you with that card.

text: Rival spies, one consensual interrogation. Agree first on the secret, the limits, and the safeword. Extract the secret using only your mouth.
aftercare: Confess your own secret was always 'I adore you,' then hold them close.

text: Room service: write a menu of very adult offerings together. One orders; the other delivers. The tip is negotiable.
aftercare: Order a real snack together afterward and eat it in bed.

text: Celebrity and superfan, both adults, both entirely willing. Decide beforehand how far the meet-and-greet goes. Then let it go there.
aftercare: Remind them they're your favorite person, no costume required.

text: The genie: your partner writes three wishes beforehand, within limits you've agreed on. Grant them one at a time, fully in character.
aftercare: Grant one bonus wish after: a cuddle of any length they choose.

text: Everyone's yes/no list is read aloud, one item at a time. No reactions allowed except a nod of thanks.
aftercare: Go around once more: everyone names one thing they're glad someone else shared.

text: Compliment circle: start sweet, and every round gets bolder. Anyone can say 'pass' or 'hold here' at any time.
aftercare: Group hug, then everyone tells the person on their left one thing they'll remember.

text: The group chooses one person to be the center of attention for five minutes. They say what's on the table; everyone else delivers.
aftercare: Whoever was the center picks who holds them afterward.

text: Before anything starts, everyone says out loud: watching, playing, or undecided. Undecided is a perfectly good answer.
aftercare: Everyone shares one thing they loved seeing or doing tonight.

text: One person directs a scene for the others: where to sit, who kisses whom, how slow. Actors check in at every cue.
aftercare: The director thanks each actor by name and asks what they'd change next time.

text: Pass a blindfold around. Whoever wears it is kissed by someone after a silent thumbs-up. They guess who.
aftercare: Lift the blindfold and let them hug whoever they guessed wrong.

text: Pick a slow scene together. Every three minutes, pause: everyone says green, yellow, or red. Any red changes the plan, no reasons needed.
aftercare: Close with everyone naming the moment they felt most cared for.

text: Everyone secretly signals: is everybody undressing together tonight? It only happens if everyone says yes.
aftercare: Pile under one big blanket and let each person say how they're feeling.

text: Two of you tease each other while one watches and directs. Rotate until everyone has had the director's chair.
aftercare: Regroup and let each director say what they enjoyed seeing most.

text: Everyone writes their wildest group fantasy anonymously. Shuffle, read aloud, vote on one to try. A single 'no' vetoes it.
aftercare: Seal the unchosen cards in an envelope for another night.
